text_block_list.text: Sorry. That was rude of me. You see...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I always brush my tail before bed, but I
just
couldn't get it right last night.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
By the time I was satisfied with the
results, it was
long past my scheduled
bedtime.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It seems Эйсин Флэш didn't get much
rest...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
